build_eval_experiment: build a linear evaluation experiment to evaluate a BYOL checkpoint on a classification dataset
run_training_step: run a single training step of the EvalExperiment with a given global step and RNG key
run_evaluation: run evaluation on a dataset subset and return loss and top1/top5 accuracy metrics
save_load_checkpoint: save or load an EvalExperiment checkpoint to persist backbone and classifier parameters
freeze_backbone_linear_eval: configure the EvalExperiment to freeze the backbone for linear evaluation instead of fine-tuning
